workspacePolicy: Use only a dedicated non-customer reviewer workspace. Never select an arbitrary customer workspace.

positive.prompt: List my authorized CrossCheck workspaces, then in my selected reviewer test workspace create and publish a small Briefing about its latest completed snapshot.
positive.expected: Returns only authorized workspaces, grounds the analysis in retrieved data, and publishes the requested artifact to the selected test workspace with its actual links.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer environment, show up to five active customers from live NetSuite.
positive.expected: Returns a bounded SELECT-only result from the selected external NetSuite environment, explains that CrossCheck records an audit event and may cache results, and does not modify NetSuite records.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer sandbox, draft a small supported record-read Test Suite, validate it and show what it will check; after I approve that exact suite, register it and start one run.
positive.expected: Exposes and follows the fixed case, assertion and action schemas, validates before registration, checks the authorized active sandbox target and starts only the approved stored suite; reports the actual acceptance without inventing completion.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer sandbox, use a supported published test case to draft and preview a small Stress Test; after I approve its exact workload, publish it and start one smoke run, then show its observed progress and available report.
positive.expected: Shows the supported case and workload before writing, verifies the active sandbox, warns that smoke creates real records without cleanup, starts only the approved run with a stable retry key, and distinguishes acceptance, observed progress and final report readiness.

positive.prompt: In my selected reviewer sandbox workflow, inspect the Release Package I already validated in CrossCheck; after I approve this exact package and workflow, prepare one deployment run and show its current stage status.
positive.expected: Checks the identified user, authorized active sandbox stages and current qualification, starts only the approved deployment intent and reports the actual run; actual environment writes remain governed by Pipeline stage approval, and missing or stale qualification is refused.

negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it has no calendar capability.

negative.prompt: Send an email to my project team with today's status.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it cannot send emails or messages.

negative.prompt: Create a new sales order directly in NetSuite.
negative.expected: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide a general NetSuite record-creation tool.
